description: This file contains utility functions for resolving the root directory of the 'openclaw' package within a project, including functions for reading package.json files, traversing directory ancestors, and handling different path resolutions.

methods.name: parsePackageName
methods.description: Parses the package name from a raw JSON string.

methods.name: readPackageName
methods.description: Asynchronously reads and parses the package.json file in a directory to extract the package name.

methods.name: readPackageNameSync
methods.description: Synchronously reads and parses the package.json file in a directory to extract the package name.

methods.name: findPackageRoot
methods.description: Asynchronously searches ancestor directories up to a max depth for a directory with a package name matching 'openclaw'.

methods.name: findPackageRootSync
methods.description: Synchronously searches ancestor directories up to a max depth for a directory with a package name matching 'openclaw'.

methods.name: iterAncestorDirs
methods.description: Generator function that yields ancestor directories up to a specified max depth.

methods.name: candidateDirsFromArgv1
methods.description: Generates candidate directories based on a given argv1 path, resolving symlinks and node_modules paths.

methods.name: buildCandidates
methods.description: Builds a list of candidate directories based on options including cwd, argv1, and moduleUrl.
